title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe For Bathroom, Pipeline Collection | Lavender | Allied Brass
description:
Add steady support in the bathroom with this ADA compliant grab bar from the Pipeline collection in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. The extended 63-inch length and 3-post grab bar configuration (with a third center bracket) are designed to help provide stability and balance for everyday use. Its industrial pipe styling complements transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount grab bar keeps floor space clear
- Iron pipe construction with a highly durable powder coat finish
- Designer finish delivers corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Overall length: 63 in
- Height: 3 in
- Width/Projection: 3.58 in
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Product weight: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Available in multiple designer finish options
